reference: The watermelon accident is messier than the phone accident.
sk: Nehoda s melónom je špinavšia než nehoda s telefónom.
cz: Nehoda s melounem je špinavější než nehoda s telefonem.
acceptable: The {watermelon|melon} accident is {messier|dirtier} than the phone {accident|one}.
The accident with the {watermelon|melon} is {messier|dirtier} than the {accident|one} with the phone.

mistakes.text: The watermelon accident is more messy than the phone accident.
The watermelon accident is messyer than the phone accident.

source_issues: Native 'špinavšia/špinavější' literally means 'dirtier'; dirtier accepted alongside messier.
